root_cause: The default public browser could not connect to bedrijfsgeheugen.nl, so prior closure fell back to Netlify provider readiness only. An independent JS-rendered public fetch later proved the site reachable and exposed a separate runtime SEO defect: the English Modelwijzer raw title was correct but a legacy SPA script overwrote document.title after JavaScript execution.
prevention: Do not treat one browser provider's connectivity failure as proof that public readback is unavailable.
Fallback to an independent external browser/fetch provider before relying on provider-state-only evidence.
For SEO pages compare raw served HTML with JS-rendered state because runtime scripts can mutate title/canonical-visible state.
Static localized canonicals remove legacy SPA tab-title mutators before publication.
fix: Use ZenRows as the independent public-browser fallback and remove #bg-tabtitel from all static localized outputs so runtime title equals canonical SEO metadata.
